svg.title: Digitised whiteboard — Solace ABT connector Spring Cloud LocalStack routes.json architecture
svg.desc: Clean digital version of the whiteboard sketch showing JSON config flowing from AWS Parameter Store via LocalStack through Spring Cloud into the ABT connector bridging Solace and MQ, with env-based key resolution and routes.json as the sole config source.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the routes.json file contain and where is it stored in Parameter Store?')
sendPrompt('How is routes.json stored in AWS Parameter Store as a SecureString parameter?')
sendPrompt('How does LocalStack emulate AWS Parameter Store SSM on localhost:4566?')
sendPrompt('Show me the awslocal command to seed /app/dev/routes into LocalStack')
sendPrompt('How does the prod profile skip LocalStack and hit real AWS SSM?')
sendPrompt('How does the connector application bootstrap routes.json from LocalStack at startup?')
g.text: Spring Boot — Solace + ABT + MQ listeners

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does Spring Cloud Config pull routes.json from LocalStack SSM using AwsParameterStorePropertySourceLocator?')
sendPrompt('How does SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev map to /app/dev/routes in LocalStack?')
sendPrompt('How does staging profile resolve to /app/staging/ inside LocalStack?')
sendPrompt('How does prod profile skip LocalStack and hit real AWS SSM /app/prod/routes?')
sendPrompt('Show me a full routes.json example for Solace to MQ and MQ to Solace stored in LocalStack')
sendPrompt('How does the connector subscribe to Solace topics defined in routes.json?')
sendPrompt('How does the ABT connector apply the transform field from routes.json?')
sendPrompt('How does the connector publish to the MQ queue named in routes[0].destination?')
sendPrompt('Why is no database needed — SSM is the only config store?')
g.text: SSM is single source of truth

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are routes changed with no UI — awslocal ssm put-parameter then actuator refresh?')
sendPrompt('How does POST /actuator/refresh reload routes.json from LocalStack without restart?')
sendPrompt('What is the exact Maven dependency for Spring Cloud AWS Parameter Store config?')
sendPrompt('Show me the application-dev.yml endpoint-override config for LocalStack')
sendPrompt('What does the prod application.yml look like — no endpoint override, IAM role only?')

svg.text: Same routes.json schema across all envs — only SSM endpoint URL differs between local and prod
